<text x="844.0" y="204.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="auto">encoder self-attention has</text>
<text x="844.0" y="226.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="auto">already mixed the context</text>
<text x="844.0" y="248.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="auto">into every position</text>
<text x="844.0" y="278.0" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#7c3aed" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="auto">so the decoder reads the right</text>
<text x="844.0" y="300.0" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#7c3aed" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="auto">content from the “wrong”</text>
<text x="844.0" y="322.0" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#7c3aed" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="auto">frames too</text>
<text x="844.0" y="352.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6b7280" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="auto">sharpness is forced only when</text>
<text x="844.0" y="374.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6b7280" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="auto">the encoder has no context</text>
<text x="844.0" y="396.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6b7280" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="auto">(raw log-mel)</text>
</g>
<text x="844.0" y="416.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6b7280" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="auto">weights are not a correspondence</text>
</svg>
